name: Breach Zero
description: The operative breaches the ringworld's inner hull. Lia detects corrupted military-grade firmware embedded in the access ports. The first human-made weapon cache on the ring is active—and it isn't friendly.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Hull breach protocols are active. This isn't alien tech—it's human military firmware. Someone prepped this ring for war.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The lockdown was a patch. A clumsy one. The ringworld's builders didn't intend for weapons caches.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Cache secured. M16A4s, MA5Cs, and a Spartan laser power cell. This is UNSC-era hardware, but modified.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The firmware retaliated. It learned. Next time it will use the ring's own systems against you.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Extraction confirmed. I'm uploading the cache schematics to the Oracle. This changes everything.

easter_eggs.name: CE Release Bug
easter_eggs.description: Fourth-wall break: the game acknowledges it is a build with known issues.
